scope: Read-only timing diagnosis of all 24 completed episodes in the three completed families. Not a replayed or executed policy comparison; unfinished optimization is excluded from this diagnostic, not from the main trial.

definitions.model_pending: Union of recorded response started/finished intervals, clipped to episode start and delivered time. Does not use outcome.seconds as model latency.
definitions.execution: Union of container dispatch.started through closure.finished, clipped to delivery. Includes launch/cleanup and CPU execution; not GPU-kernel utilization.
definitions.pure_model_pending: Duration(model union) minus duration(intersection(model union, execution union)).
definitions.conditional_limit: For successful episodes retain every recorded serial execution-envelope duration, remove all time outside them. Failed episodes stay at the prespecified 7200 seconds. This is conditional arithmetic, not a measured speedup or a physically achievable schedule.
necessary_assumptions: Same admitted/executed methods, successful/failed outcomes, confirmation and final selection path.

Same serial execution-envelope durations. Changed hardware contention, per-method budgets, parallel evaluation, early stopping, speculative exploration or omitted executions fall outside this calculation.
No prediction of changed model outputs or success rate. No full-campaign mean or uncertainty claimed.

decision: Do not prioritize an async-only framework justified by deleting observed model/coordination waits while preserving the current candidate execution path: even deleting all nonexecution time leaves both vision and regression slower than observed control, so this restricted change cannot satisfy the existing >=3 faster families rule. Prioritize independently testing method quality/selection and exploration-to-delivery decisions after the frozen trial closes. This does not reject the broader SIFT strategy or all asynchronous research policies.

paper_connection.author_result: Asynchronous expansion/evaluation supplies most measured SIFT speedup; judge-guided speculative expansion contributes additional gains.
paper_connection.local_limit: SIFT speculative expansion changes the search path. The conditional arithmetic above only covers wait removal with the existing serial execution path retained; paper speedups do not transfer numerically to orze.
